N08#1.zh: 林冲！你死定了！你们这些旁边的人、还想要命的话就不要插手！
N08#1.t: Lin Chong! You're dead! The rest of you, if you value your lives, stay out of it!

N08#2.zh: 哼，一对一打不过就想要用人海战术？各位，我们也去帮林教头！
N08#2.t: Hmph, can't win one on one so you send a crowd? Everyone, let's help Instructor Lin too!

N08#3.zh: 啊哈！我的拳头又想揍人了！
N08#3.t: Aha! My fists are itching for a fight again!

N08#5.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N08#7.zh: 失败条件   --- 林冲死亡

N08#11.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N08#12.zh: %N在乱斗之中被击重伤，众好汉不敌人多，相继败下阵来，柴进虽极力劝解，但众好汉经此挫败，再无颜面寄住府中，遂告别而去；不日高俅追兵追至，众人大败而走，从此不知所踪........
N08#12.t: %N was badly hurt in the brawl, and the outnumbered heroes fell one after another. Chai Jin tried to make peace, but after such a defeat the heroes were too ashamed to stay and took their leave. Soon Gao Qiu's pursuers caught up, the group was routed, and they were never heard of again........

N08#13.zh: 林冲败于洪教头棒下，众好汉再无颜面寄住府中，遂告别柴进，继续着亡命的生涯；林冲遭此重挫之后，从此郁郁寡欢，众人再也闯不出名堂，于是分道扬镳，四散而去........
N08#13.t: Lin Chong fell to Instructor Hong's staff. Too ashamed to stay at the manor, the heroes took leave of Chai Jin and went on living as fugitives. After this blow Lin Chong was never happy again, the group never made a name for themselves, and they went their separate ways........

N08#16.zh: 洪教头！你把我柴进庄上当作什么东西？不但毫无习武之人的风度，而且还纠众滋事，带着徒弟打群架！
N08#16.t: Instructor Hong! What do you take my manor for? Not only do you lack a martial artist's grace, you stir up trouble and bring your disciples to brawl!

N08#18.zh: 滚！我柴进虽然接纳天下三教九流之士，却不欢迎你这种人！
N08#18.t: Get out! I may welcome men of every walk of life, but not your kind!

N08#20.zh: 哼！此处不留爷，必有留爷处！徒弟们，我们走！
N08#20.t: Hmph! If I'm not wanted here, someone else will want me! Disciples, we're leaving!

N08#21.zh: 林冲！你给我小心一点！你这颗人头就暂且寄放在你的脖子上！
N08#21.t: Lin Chong! You'd better watch yourself! Your head is only on loan to your neck for now!

N08#23.zh: 洪教头与林冲结下梁子，离开柴家庄。
N08#23.t: Instructor Hong, now Lin Chong's sworn enemy, leaves the Chai manor.
